verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis for a SaaS email platform with a public API, so the story applies. Direct probes found nothing: llms.txt returns 404, the markdown docs variant returns 404, and every candidate OpenAPI path returns 404. The only documentation in evidence is conventional human-readable API reference pages, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
